  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-opw2ln",
      "toKey": "n-1qdd5sx",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The area directory (n-opw2ln) defines the service routing and locations but explicitly states it does not establish valve positions or pressure availability at any given time. The point register (IA-P02, n-1qdd5sx) maps signals only and confirms that distribution valve states are unknown from records alone.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1","da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-nk53l1", "claim-q5q9qj", "claim-isa9wb"],
      "counterfactual": "If the directory or register had established valve states, we would expect a record of open/closed positions; their absence leaves valve state unknown.",
      "competingExplanation": "A physical change in routing occurred but was not recorded because records are limited to mapping signals and location indices rather than real-time field conditions.","evidenceGap":"No direct evidence exists confirming whether an unrecorded service-routing change actually happened or if the blank attachment field reflects a missing temporary instruction versus no change at all. The incident description notes that supporting records will be provided as investigation develops, but none are currently in this packet to confirm routing changes."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1qdd5sx",
      "toKey": "n-nrva0b",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The point register's limitation (n-1qdd5sx) means that a blank temporary instruction field on the work package cover (n-nrva0b) does not prove whether a service-routing change occurred or was documented. The lack of evidence for valve states and routing changes leaves this as an unresolved gap.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1","eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-nk53l1", "claim-q5q9qj", "claim-isa9wb","claim-1p43v5g","claim-16hd9fn"],
      "counterfactual": "If the point register had captured valve states, we could determine whether a routing change occurred and if it was properly documented.",
      "competingExplanation": "The blank field may simply reflect incomplete documentation rather than an unrecorded service-routing change; however, without evidence of actual valve positions or routing changes, this remains speculative.","evidenceGap":"No direct record confirms the existence or absence of a specific unrecorded routing change. The incident description states that supporting records will be provided as investigation develops, but none are currently available in this packet."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-nrva0b",
      "toKey": "n-vay2a6",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The work package cover (IA-S02, n-nrva0b) shows a blank temporary instruction attachment field at issue time. The requirement document (IA-D03, n-vay2a6) states that when a service-routing change affects an existing maintenance boundary, the affected ECP must be revised or have an approved temporary instruction attached.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1","0ff450fe-49da-4c67-8b42-35449fdad35c#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-nk53l1", "claim-q5q9qj", "claim-isa9wb","claim-1p43v5g","claim-16hd9fn"],
      "counterfactual": "If the temporary instruction field had been filled with an approved document, it would indicate compliance with the requirement for revising or attaching a temporary instruction when service-routing changes occur.",
      "competingExplanation":"The blank field may reflect incomplete documentation rather than non-compliance; however, without evidence of actual valve positions or routing changes, this remains speculative.","evidenceGap":"No direct record confirms whether a service-routing change occurred that would have triggered the requirement for revising an ECP or attaching a temporary instruction."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The investigation identifies three supported causal links: (1) The area directory and point register limitations mean valve states are unknown, creating uncertainty about whether a service-routing change occurred. (2) This uncertainty leads to the conclusion that a blank temporary instruction field does not prove compliance or non-compliance with requirements for revising ECPs when routing changes occur. (3) The requirement document mandates revision of affected ECPs or attachment of approved temporary instructions when service-routing changes affect maintenance boundaries, but no evidence confirms whether such a change occurred in this case.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1", "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1", "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1", "0ff450fe-49da-4c67-8b42-35449fdad35c#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Whether a service-routing change occurred that would have triggered the requirement for revising an ECP or attaching a temporary instruction.", "The actual state of distribution valves at the time of the incident."],
    "alternatives": ["A physical routing change occurred but was not recorded due to record limitations. A blank field reflects incomplete documentation rather than non-compliance with requirements.", "No service-routing change occurred, and the blank field is unrelated to compliance issues."],
    "confidence": 0.75
  },"evidenceRequests":[
    "requestId-1",
    "sourceId:eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1,claimRef=finding-nk53l1"
  ]}
